misconceptions.description: Logging the maximum available telemetry with no link to a specific design question, on the assumption that more data is always safer for the project
misconceptions.trigger: learner proposes capturing all events, video, or location without naming the question each field answers
misconceptions.feedback: Tie every logged field to a question it answers. Data you cannot justify is risk you cannot justify.

misconceptions.description: Assuming that removing names makes telemetry anonymous, ignoring re-identification from combined quasi-identifiers
misconceptions.trigger: learner claims the data is anonymous solely because direct identifiers were dropped
misconceptions.feedback: Check whether timestamps, section, and rare patterns could single someone out. Removing the name is necessary but not sufficient.

misconceptions.description: Treating consent as something that can be obtained after data is reused, or as covering any later purpose once data exists
misconceptions.trigger: learner reuses logs for a purpose outside the original disclosure, or plans to ask permission only if challenged
misconceptions.feedback: Bind use to the purpose learners agreed to. A new purpose needs new consent before the data moves.
